title: Something went wrong
crashLoop: Riff crashed again straight away, so reloading is unlikely to help. Starting from default settings ignores everything saved — your settings file is not changed. If that still fails, run `riff repair` in a terminal.

code.io: Riff could not read or write a file.
code.parse: A file on disk is not valid JSON.
code.not-found: Riff could not find what it needed.
code.score-missing: This score could not be found. It may have been moved or deleted.
code.score-encrypted: This score is password-protected. Riff cannot open a password-protected file.
code.score-unreadable: This score could not be read. It may not be a PDF, or the file may be damaged.

settingsRecovered: Your settings file could not be read. Riff started from defaults and kept the original at {{path}}.
settingsWriteFailed: Riff could not save your settings. Your choices are still applied, and it will try again on the next change.
decorationsRefused: Your window manager refused to draw system decorations, so Riff kept its own title bar.
settingsWriteBlocked: Your settings file could not be read, and Riff could not move it aside — so it will not write over it. Changes you make now apply until you quit and are then lost. Rename or fix {{path}}, then restart Riff.
settingsEditInvalid: Your edit to settings.json could not be read, so nothing changed: {{detail}}.
